title: CF Meet service trust bundle v1
description: Receiver-controlled trust policy of one service in one runtime environment: which issuers it accepts, with which Ed25519 public keys, and which internal permissions it grants each of them. Permissions are target-service authoritative; tokens never carry them. Services additionally refuse to start when: receiver or runtime_environment differ from their own configuration; an issuer appears twice or equals the receiver; a kid appears twice; a public key is not a valid, non-weak Ed25519 point; a permission is not received by this service or may not be granted to that issuer (e.g. protected-contact.resolve-for-execution is grantable only to cfmeet.telephony by cfmeet.privacy-relay).

TrustedIssuer.description: Grant for (issuer, audience, runtime_environment). audience and runtime_environment must equal the bundle's receiver and runtime_environment.

keys.description: Accepted public keys. Two keys are present only during a key rotation overlap.

PublicKey.description: Ed25519 public key as an OKP JSON Web Key (RFC 8037).
